castTime.binNote: Bin's EvelynnQ.castTime is 0.25 but the wiki states the initial cast time as {{fd|0.3}} with recast being None; recording the wiki's value per instructions and noting the disagreement.

values.binNote: No bin row stores the mark duration; the sheet has no such value, only stack count and per-hit damage.

values.meaning: number of bonus-damage attacks/abilities against marked target

values.quote: may be recast up to 3 times at no cost until the ability comes off cooldown
values.binNote: No dedicated data value for the number of recasts exists in the sheet; it is implied by the 4x total damage tooltip but not stated as its own row.
Wiki's custominfo gives 0.5s between recasts; the bin's EvelynnQ.FakeCD=4 is a different value (matches the wiki-listed base cooldown of 4, not the barrage interval), so it is not used here.

mechanics.claim: The dart marks the first enemy hit; Evelynn's next 3 basic attacks (on-hit) or abilities against the marked target deal bonus magic damage.
mechanics.quote: '''Evelynn's''' next 3 {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} or {{tip|abilities}} against the marked target deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.

mechanics.claim: The recast is a separate line-shaped AoE hitting all enemies hit, not just the marked target.
mechanics.quote: '''Evelynn''' unleashes a line of deadly spikes in the direction of the nearest {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies struck.

mechanics.claim: Recasts are free (no additional mana cost) and are limited to 3 uses until the ability's cooldown resets.
mechanics.quote: ''Hate Spike'' may be recast up to 3 times at no cost until the ability comes off cooldown.

mechanics.claim: The initial dart applies spell damage (not on-hit) while the recast spikes deal area damage as separate instances.
mechanics.quote: The dart applies {{tip|spell damage}} and the spikes deal {{tip|area damage}}.

mechanics.claim: Each cast (including recasts) counts as a separate ability activation for on-cast effects.
mechanics.quote: Each cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: A nearby visible enemy is required in order to recast the ability.
mechanics.quote: ''A nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy is required to recast this ability.''
